conflicts.text: Machine: the operator inbox (today the operator_inbox tool, 19.17) builds the to-do list from live state, storing nothing.
conflicts.ticket_says: D3 directly imports operator_inbox as a Python module from cairn/tools/, with CodeMother executing `python3 -m cairn.tools.operator_inbox.inbox show artifact` to reach it
conflicts.why: Outline 8.2.7 intends operator_inbox to transition from today's tool (19.17) to a machine under the Operator device. Once it becomes a machine, CodeMother cannot import its internals directly; it must reach the Operator device over the bus per RULE 1 and 2.2.8 (devices talk to other devices only through public interface/bus). The import path also becomes invalid when code moves from cairn/tools/ to cairn/devices/operator/machines/.
